vo.en: Press your arms here right now.

visual.description: A man points directly at the camera with an intense, focused expression in a dimly lit room.

vo.en: Find a doorway and push the back of your hands against the frame as hard as you possibly can.

visual.description: Close up of a man's tensed hands pressing outward against a wooden door frame.

vo.en: Keep pushing. Your brain is sending a constant electrical signal to your muscles, but your arms aren't moving.

visual.description: Abstract digital animation of glowing blue neural pathways and electrical pulses moving fast.

vo.en: Wait, it gets even weirder. Hold it for ten more seconds until your shoulders literally start to shake.

visual.description: Extreme close up of a man's shoulder muscles twitching and vibrating under heavy physical strain.

vo.en: Now, step away and let your arms hang loose. Watch as they float up involuntarily like you’re being possessed.

visual.description: A man stands in a hallway and his arms slowly rise up to his sides without him moving them.

vo.en: This is the Kohnstamm reflex, a brain hack that overrides your control. Subscribe for more tests and comment YES if it worked, which is exactly why

visual.description: A man looks at his hands in disbelief then looks up to smile and point at a digital button.
